user_query: I'm organizing a company retreat and need some assistance. Can you provide me with the population of the city where the retreat will be held? Also, I'm interested in the historic views and subscribers of a YouTube channel related to team building. Lastly, I would like to perform a DNS lookup to retrieve the name servers associated with a specific domain.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the population of the city where the retreat will be held.
Retrieve historic views data of a specific YouTube channel related to team building.
Retrieve the subscriber count of the specified YouTube channel.
Perform a DNS lookup to get the name servers associated with a specific domain.
